stance: Housing is weak at a low level. September starts fell 5.2% to 1,221k SAAR after -5.9%. Permits held near 1,400k (-0.2%), the leading signal, so starts should stabilise. New home sales of 676k (-0.6% after +5.1%) were flat on the month, giving no sign of a rebound. Existing sales of 3.99M (+1.5%) are lagging closings, and mortgage rates near 7.4% cap affordability. Residential investment is a GDP drag. Permits below 1,350k or new home sales falling further would confirm deterioration. View is provisional.
